title: Dr. Soleymani receives prestigious Dorothy Killam Fellowship
content: Dr. Soleymani has been awarded the Dorothy Killam Fellowship to support her research on next-generation wearable devices for early disease detection and prevention.

title: New Publication in Nature Reviews Bioengineering
content: Our latest work on 'Integrated hydrogel microneedle aptamer sensor for wearable insulin monitoring' has been published in Nature Reviews Bioengineering. Congratulations to Dr. Mayank Garg, Stephen Chupil, Jonathan L’Heureux-Hache for this incredible work!

title: Welcome New Graduate Students
content: The Soleymani Lab is excited to welcome one new MASc student and three PhD candidates to the group this fall semester.
